title: Business Analyst
description: A career roadmap for bridging business needs and technology delivery through requirements, processes, data, and stakeholder analysis.

tree.name: Business Analysis Foundations
tree.description: Learn what business analysts do: clarify problems, elicit requirements, document workflows, and support delivery teams.

resources.title: IIBA Business Analysis Body of Knowledge

children.name: Stakeholder Analysis
children.description: Identify users, sponsors, blockers, decision makers, communication needs, and approval flows.

children.name: Requirement Elicitation
children.description: Use interviews, workshops, observation, surveys, document analysis, and prototypes to discover requirements.

tree.name: Process and Data Analysis
tree.description: Model workflows, data movement, current-state gaps, future-state processes, and measurable improvements.

resources.title: BPMN Tutorial for Beginners (The Agile Business Analyst)

children.name: Process Mapping
children.description: Create flowcharts, BPMN diagrams, swimlanes, SIPOC, and gap analysis documents.

children.name: SQL, Excel, and Dashboards
children.description: Analyze business data with SQL, spreadsheets, pivots, charts, and simple BI dashboards.

children.name: Practice: Current-to-Future Process Map
children.description: Document an existing workflow, identify gaps, design the target process, and list requirement changes.

tree.name: Agile Delivery and Portfolio
tree.description: Convert business needs into backlog items, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and implementation-ready artifacts.

children.name: User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
children.description: Write actionable user stories, business rules, non-functional requirements, and testable acceptance criteria.

children.name: Project: Requirements Package
children.description: Document a real business workflow with stakeholder map, process diagrams, requirements, wireframes, and test scenarios.

tree.name: Tools, UAT, and Career Readiness
tree.description: Use common BA tools, support user acceptance testing, and build artifacts that show delivery impact.

children.name: Jira, Confluence, and Traceability
children.description: Manage epics, stories, decisions, assumptions, requirement traceability, and change requests.

children.name: UAT and Release Support
children.description: Plan UAT scenarios, coordinate sign-offs, triage defects, update training docs, and support rollout.
